prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: approval design image for Rakky Ride rider Safety Center.
Primary request: ONE complete beautiful, practical mobile safety-center screen. Flat front-on screenshot, logical phone size 390 x 844, no phone frame or perspective. White-forward clean ride-hailing interface, compact restrained Inter-like text: header15px, section/row titles14px, descriptions13px. Utility icons16–18px in32px circles, back target44–48px. Forest green is the brand action color; emergency red is reserved for calling emergency services; amber for guidance only. Subtle silver borders, soft mint or red tints, small radii. No large hero illustration, no oversized words, no dark default. Avoid gradients.
Screen layout and exact text:
- Small ordinary phone status bar.
- Compact header with pale silver circular back arrow, small title "Safety center", and a small green shield outline at far right. Thin silver divider.
- First card is the clear emergency priority. Very pale red surface, subtle red border, 14px title "Emergency help" next to a small phone outline in a pale red circle. One brief line below "In immediate danger? Call public emergency services." 13px with natural wrapping. A full-width solid dark-red 44px button with small phone icon and white label "Call 112". Below the button, a compact secondary red text action "Lagos emergency line: 767". At the bottom of the card a tiny muted 12px explanation "Opens your phone dialer." No SOS countdown and no claimed automatic dispatch.
- A compact section heading row "Your safety tools" 14px, with subtle gray "No active trip" pill on right, small13px.
- Three compact full-width utility rows, white surfaces, silver dividers/borders, consistent 32px icon circles, no huge tiles:
  1 small share-arrow outline, title "Share trip details", body "Available during an active trip." Right a subtle inactive chevron. This row is visually inactive because there is no active trip. Do NOT say live location or live tracking link.
  2 small person-with-shield outline, title "Trusted contacts", body "Coming soon". Right a small muted lock icon. This is an unavailable feature with no switch, no On state, and no Add contact action.
  3 small support-headset outline in mint circle, title "Non-emergency support", body "View contact options and availability." Right a green chevron. Do NOT promise 24/7 support, fast response, staffed operators, or an incident form.
- Lower section titled "Before and during your ride" in14px.
- One white/silver bordered compact guidance card with three short lines, each paired with a small conventional outline icon:
  car + plate symbol: "Match the driver, car and plate."
  seat-belt symbol: "Wear your seat belt."
  small lock symbol: "Keep login codes private."
  Use13px text with comfortable line spacing, no long paragraphs, no promotional claim.
- At bottom a restrained green shield icon with small muted text "Safety tools, clearly within reach." and normal phone home indicator.
Constraints: one screen fully fits, no cropped content or spelling errors. All text exactly as specified. All actions have comfortable touch targets without large visual glyphs. No maps, no fake active-trip details, no names, phone contacts, addresses, login codes, personal data, location coordinates, security scores, insurance promises, recording controls, automatic crash detection, emergency-agent chat, unsupported live-tracking promises, or claims that all safety features already exist. The design must honestly show the inactive trip-sharing and planned trusted contacts states. Emergency and non-emergency help are visually distinct.
